headline: Texas Instruments Inc's Dividend Analysis
summary: Texas Instruments Inc (NASDAQ:TXN) recently announced a total dividend of $1.42 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This includes a $1.42 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-11.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
